	end

function v_u_2.crateOdds(p11) -- name: crateOdds
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v12 = v_u_2.Crates[p11]
	local v13 = {}
	for v14, v15 in not v12 and {} or v12.Pool do
		local v16 = v_u_2.Items[v15.Id]
		if not v16 then
			continue
		end
		local v17 = {
			["Id"] = v15.Id,
			["Rarity"] = v16.Rarity,
			["Percent"] = v15.Chance,
			["at"] = v14
		}
		table.insert(v13, v17)
	end
	table.sort(v13, function(p18, p19)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2
		local v20 = p18.Rarity
		if v20 then
			v20 = v_u_2.Rarities[v20]
		end
		local v21 = not v20 and 0 or v20.Order
		local v22 = p19.Rarity
		if v22 then
			v22 = v_u_2.Rarities[v22]
		end
		if v21 == (not v22 and 0 or v22.Order) then
			if p18.Percent == p19.Percent then

				end

		end
	end
end

function v_u_2.cardRarity(p229, p230, p231) -- name: cardRarity
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v232 = v_u_2.Cards[p229]
	local v233
	if p231 then
		local v234 = v232.Guarantee10
		if v234 then
			v234 = v_u_2.Rarities[v234]
		end
		v233 = not v234 and 0 or v234.Order
	else
		v233 = 0
	end
	local v235 = {}
	local v236 = 0
	for v237, v238 in v232.Odds do

			v239 = v_u_2.Rarities[v237]

	end
	table.sort(v235, function(p240, p241)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2

		end

			p241 = v_u_2.Rarities[p241]
		end

	end)

			continue
		end

	end

end

function v_u_2.selfTest() -- name: selfTest
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_109, (copy) v_u_101, (copy) v_u_94
	for _, v363 in v_u_2.CardTiers do
		local v364 = v_u_2.Cards[v363]
		local v365 = 0
		for v366, v367 in v364.Odds do
			v365 = v365 + v367
			local v368 = #v_u_2.cardPool(v366) > 0
			local v369 = v363 .. " has no " .. v366 .. " cards"
			assert(v368, v369)
		end
		local v370 = v365 - 100
		local v371 = math.abs(v370) < 1e-6
		local v372 = v363 .. " odds sum to " .. v365
		assert(v371, v372)
		local v373 = v364.Odds[v364.Guarantee10]
		local v374 = v363 .. " guarantee"
		assert(v373, v374)
		local v375 = v_u_2.cardPack(v363, 1)
		if v375 then
			v375 = v_u_2.cardPack(v363, 10)
		end
		local v376 = v363 .. " packs"
		assert(v375, v376)
	end
	for v377 in v_u_2.CardPacks do
		local v378 = v_u_2.get(v377)
		if v378 then
			v378 = v_u_2.shopPrice(v377) == "Robux"
		end
		local v379 = v377 .. " price"
		assert(v378, v379)
	end
	for _, v380 in v_u_2.Cards.Limited do
		local v381 = v_u_2.Items[v380]
		if v381 then
			if v381.Kind == "Banner" then
				v381 = v_u_2.dustCost(v380) == nil
			else
				v381 = false
			end
		end
		local v382 = v380 .. " limited"
		assert(v381, v382)
	end
	local v383 = v_u_2.RollPacks[v_u_2.RollDeal.Pack]
	if v383 then
		v383 = v_u_2.RollPacks[v_u_2.RollDeal.Pack].Deal
	end
	assert(v383, "roll deal pack")
	for v384, v385 in v_u_2.Items do
		local v386 = v385.Coins == nil and true or v385.Coins == v_u_2.CoinPrices[v385.Rarity]
		local v387 = v384 .. " coin price follows CoinPrices"
		assert(v386, v387)
	end
	for _, v388 in v_u_2.crateList() do
		local v389 = v_u_2.Crates[v388]
		local v390 = v_u_2.crateOdds(v388)
		local v391 = 0
		for _, v392 in v390 do
			v391 = v391 + v392.Percent
		end
		local v393
		if #v390 == #v389.Pool then
			local v394 = v391 - 100
			v393 = math.abs(v394) < 1e-6
		else
			v393 = false
		end
		local v395 = v388 .. " odds sum to " .. v391
		assert(v393, v395)
		if v389.Coins then
			local v396 = v_u_2.crateCoins(v388) == v389.Coins and (v389.Coins > 0 and v389.Pity == nil) and not v_u_2.cratePack(v388, 1)
			if v396 then
				v396 = not v_u_2.cratePack(v388, 10)
			end
			local v397 = v388 .. " coin pack"
			assert(v396, v397)
		else
			local v398 = v_u_2.cratePack(v388, 1)
			if v398 then
				v398 = v_u_2.cratePack(v388, 10)
			end
			local v399 = v388 .. " Robux packs"
			assert(v398, v399)
		end
	end

function v_u_3.shownOdds() -- name: shownOdds

	local v29 = {}

			["id"] = v32,
			["i"] = v31,
			["whole"] = v35,
			["rest"] = v33 - v35
		}
		table.insert(v29, v36)
		v30 = v30 + v35
	end
	local v37 = table.clone(v29)
	table.sort(v37, function(p38, p39)
		local v40 = p38.rest - p39.rest
		if math.abs(v40) > 1e-9 then
			return p38.rest > p39.rest

			return p38.i < p39.i
		end
	end)
	local v41 = 1000 - v30 + 0.5
	local v42 = math.floor(v41)
	local v43 = #v37

		local v45 = v37[v44]

function v_u_3.pickRarity(p52, p53) -- name: pickRarity

function v_u_3.ftueRoll(p76, p77) -- name: ftueRoll
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v78
	if p76 then
		v78 = p76:NextNumber()
	else
		v78 = math.random()
	end
	local v79
	if p76 then
		v79 = p76:NextNumber()
	else
		v79 = math.random()
	end
	local v80 = v_u_3.Gacha.FtueBands
	local v81 = 0
	for _, v82 in v_u_3.RarityOrder do
		v81 = v81 + (v80[v82] or 0)
	end
	local v83 = v78 * v81
	local v84 = "Common"
	for _, v85 in v_u_3.RarityOrder do
		if (v80[v85] or 0) <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		v83 = v83 - v80[v85]
		if v83 < 0 then
			v84 = v85
			break
		end
		v84 = v85
	end
	if type(p77) == "table" then
		local v86 = v_u_3.Rank[v84]
		local v87 = {}
		for v88 = v86, #v_u_3.RarityOrder do
			local v89 = v_u_3.RarityOrder[v88]
			table.insert(v87, v89)
		end
		for v90 = v86 - 1, 1, -1 do
			local v91 = v_u_3.RarityOrder[v90]
			table.insert(v87, v91)
		end
		for _, v92 in v87 do
			local v93 = {}
			for _, v94 in v_u_3.pool(v92) do
				local v95 = p77[v94]
				if (tonumber(v95) or 0) >= 1 then

				end
				table.insert(v93, v94)
			end
			if #v93 <= 0 then
				break
			end
			local v96 = v79 * #v93
			local v97 = math.floor(v96) + 1
			local v98 = #v93
			return v93[math.clamp(v97, 1, v98)], v92
		end

local function v_u_556(p552, p553) -- name: onInput
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_217, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_218, (copy) v_u_223, (ref) v_u_341, (copy) v_u_10

			if v555 then
				v555 = v_u_12.Camera

local function v_u_654(p630, p631, p632) -- name: stepMissiles
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_45, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_608, (copy) v_u_67
	local v633 = v_u_6.Defs["item.missile"].Params

		else

					end

end

local function v_u_118() -- name: stepShot

local function v_u_194() -- name: easeOut
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_29
	local v181 = v_u_23
	local v182 = 360 / (v_u_21 and v_u_21.n or 8)
	local v183 = v_u_22
	local v184, v185
	if v181.answer == "prize" then
		v184 = v_u_10:GetAttribute("ReduceFlashing") == true and 2.8 or 4.2
		local v186 = v181.result.Wedge
		local v187 = tonumber(v186) or 1
		v181.wedge = v187
		local v188 = -(v187 - 1) * v182 + v_u_29:NextNumber(-14, 14)
		local v189 = (v183 + 720 - v188) / 360
		v185 = v188 + math.ceil(v189) * 360
	else
		v184 = 0.9
		local v190 = (v183 + v181.v * v184 / 2) / v182
		v185 = math.ceil(v190) * v182
	end
	v181.phase = "ease"
	v181.t = 0
	v181.from = v183
	v181.to = v185
	v181.time = v184
	local v191 = v181.v * v184
	local v192 = v185 - v183
	local v193 = v191 / math.max(v192, 1)
	v181.power = math.clamp(v193, 1.5, 5)
end

end

local function v_u_265(p249, p250, p251) -- name: drawChrome

local function v_u_500(p447) -- name: prepare
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_38, (ref) v_u_39, (ref) v_u_37, (ref) v_u_30, (copy) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_25, (ref) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_154, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_35
	if v_u_38 or (not v_u_39 or (not v_u_37 or (v_u_30 < 2 or (type(p447) ~= "table" or not v_u_9.inMatch())))) then
		return nil
	end
	local v448 = v_u_19:GetAttribute("Phase")
	if v448 ~= "Replay" and v448 ~= "Goal" then
		return nil
	end
	local v449 = p447.goalTime
	if type(v449) ~= "number" or (v449 ~= v449 or math.abs(v449) == (1 / 0)) then
		v449 = nil
	end
	if not v449 then
		return nil
	end
	local v450 = p447.startTime
	if type(v450) ~= "number" or (v450 ~= v450 or math.abs(v450) == (1 / 0)) then
		v450 = nil
	end
	local v451 = v450 or v449 - (v_u_20.MinLead or 2.5)
	local v452 = math.min(v451, v449)
	local v453 = p447.slowFrom
	if type(v453) ~= "number" or (v453 ~= v453 or math.abs(v453) == (1 / 0)) then
		v453 = nil
	end
	local v454 = v453 or v449 - (v_u_20.SlowWindow or 1)
	local v455 = math.clamp(v454, v452, v449)
	local v456 = p447.endTime
	if type(v456) ~= "number" or (v456 ~= v456 or math.abs(v456) == (1 / 0)) then
		v456 = nil
	end
	local v457 = v456 or v449 + (v_u_20.Tail or 0.5)

local function v_u_142(p136, p137, p138, p139, _, p140, p141) -- name: onMatchEvent
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_34, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_107, (copy) v_u_135

			end

	end
end

local function v_u_324(p300, p301, p302) -- name: stepSlots
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_299
	local v303
	if p301.itemOn == true then
		v303 = p300.scheme ~= "Touch"
	else
		v303 = false
	end
	if p300.heldDock.Visible ~= v303 then
		p300.heldDock.Visible = v303
	end
	local v304 = p301.itemStunned == true
	local v305 = p302 * 3.141592653589793 * 3
	local v306 = 0.5 - math.cos(v305) * 0.5
	for v307, v308 in p300.slots do
		local v309
		if p301.itemOn == true then
			v309 = p301.itemSlots
		else
			v309 = nil
		end
		local v310
		if type(v309) == "table" then
			v310 = v309[v307]
		else
			v310 = nil
		end
		if type(v310) ~= "table" or v310.def == nil then
			v310 = nil
		end
		local v311
		if v310 then
			v311 = v310.def
		else
			v311 = nil
		end
		v_u_299(v308, v311, v310 and (v310.uses or 0) or 0, v304, p300.slotNameW)
		local v312 = v308.popUntil - p302
		local v313
		if v312 <= 0 then
			v313 = 1
		else
			local v314 = v312 / v308.popTime
			v313 = 1 + (v308.popFrom - 1) * v314 * v314
		end
		if v311 and not v304 then
			local v315
			if p300.coach == nil or p300.coach.slot ~= v307 then
				v315 = false
			else
				v315 = p300.coach.def == v311
			end
			v313 = v313 * ((v315 and 0.18 or 0.08) * v306 + 1)
			for _, v316 in v308.glow do
				v316.stroke.Transparency = v316.base + (1 - v306) * 0.2
			end
		end
		v308.scale.Scale = v313
		local v317 = v308.note
		local v318
		if v303 then
			v318 = p302 < v308.noteUntil
		else
			v318 = v303
		end
		v317.Visible = v318
		local v319 = v308.shakeUntil - p302
		if v319 > 0 then
			local v320 = v308.ring
			local v321 = v308.home
			local v322 = UDim2.fromOffset
			local v323 = p302 * 70
			v320.Position = v321 + v322(math.sin(v323) * 6 * v319 / 0.25, 0)
			v308.shaking = true
		else
			if not v308.shaking then
				continue
			end
			v308.shaking = false
			v308.ring.Position = v308.home
		end
	end
end

function v_u_23.update(p503, p504) -- name: update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_324, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_142, (copy) v_u_79, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_457, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_201, (copy) v_u_380, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_235, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_1
	local v505 = os.clock()
	local v506 = p504.waveTotal <= 0 and 0 or p504.waveLeft / p504.waveTotal
	local v507 = p504.waveLeft > 0.02
	p503.arcClip.Visible = v507
	p503.arcGradient.Rotation = (1 - math.clamp(v506, 0, 1)) * 90
	v_u_6.setText(p503.cooldownText, not v507 and "" or string.format("%.1f", p504.waveLeft))
	v_u_324(p503, p504, v505)
	local v508
	if v_u_27 then
		v508 = false
	else
		if p504.ultId and (p504.ultDef and p504.ultId ~= p503.ultId) then
			v_u_142(p503, p504.ultId, p504.ultDef)
		end
		local v509 = p503.ultPalette
		local v510
		if p504.ultCharge >= 100 then
			v510 = p504.ultRemaining <= 0
		else
			v510 = false
		end
		local v511 = p504.ultRemaining > 0
		if v510 then
			v508 = p504.ultBlocked ~= nil
		else
			v508 = v510
		end
		local v512
		if v511 then
			local v513 = p504.ultRemaining
			local v514 = p504.ultDuration
			v512 = v513 / math.max(0.01, v514)
		else
			local v515 = p504.ultCharge / 100
			v512 = math.clamp(v515, 0, 1)
		end
		p503.dial.Visible = not v510
		local v516 = v_u_79
		local v517 = v512 * 24 + 0.0001
		local v518 = math.floor(v517)
		local v519
		if v511 then
			v519 = v509.live
		else
			v519 = v_u_14.UltDash
		end
		v516(p503, v518, v519)
		p503.ultSolid.Visible = v510
		p503.ultSolidStroke.Transparency = v508 and 0.6 or 0
		for _, v520 in p503.ultGlow do
			local v521 = v520.ring
			local v522
			if v510 then
				v522 = not v508
			else
				v522 = v510
			end
			v521.Visible = v522
		end
		p503.ultIcon.Visible = v510
		if v508 ~= p503.ultIconDim then
			p503.ultIconDim = v508
			local v523 = v508 and 0.6 or 0
			for v524, v525 in p503.ultIconBase do
				v_u_6.setIconAlpha(v524, v525 + (1 - v525) * v523)

function v_u_12.countCoins(p304, p305, p306) -- name: countCoins
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v307 = p304.chips
	if p305 <= 0 and #v307 == 0 then
		p304.coinLabel.Text = "+0"
		v_u_5.sound("CoinTick", {
			["Volume"] = 0.5
		})
	else
		local v308 = #v307
		local v309 = math.max(1, v308)
		local v310
		if #v307 > 0 then
			local v311 = 0.6 / v309
			v310 = math.max(0.2, v311)
		else
			v310 = 0.6
		end
		local v312 = os.clock()
		local v313 = 0
		local v314 = 0
		local v315 = -1
		for v316 = 1, v309 do
			local v317 = v307[v316]
			if v317 then
				v313 = v313 + v317.amount
				v317.frame.Visible = true
				v317.pop.Scale = 1.35
				v_u_5.tween(v317.pop, v_u_5.M.Pop, {
					["Scale"] = 1
				})
				v317.stroke.Transparency = 0
				v_u_5.tween(v317.stroke, v_u_5.info(0.35), {
					["Transparency"] = 0.55
				})
			end
			local v318
			if v316 == v309 then
				v318 = p305
			else
				local v319 = math.min(v313, p305)
				v318 = math.max(v314, v319)
			end
			local v320 = os.clock()
			while true do
				if p304.serial ~= p306 then
					return false
				end
				local v321 = (os.clock() - v320) / v310
				local v322 = math.clamp(v321, 0, 1)
				local v323 = v314 + (v318 - v314) * (1 - (1 - v322) * (1 - v322)) + 0.5
				local v324 = math.floor(v323)
				if v324 == v315 then
					v324 = v315
				else
					p304.coinLabel.Text = "+" .. v324
					local v325 = v_u_5.sound
					local v326 = {
						["PlaybackSpeed"] = nil,
						["Volume"] = 0.5
					}
					local v327 = (os.clock() - v312) / (v310 * v309)
					v326.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp(v327, 0, 1) * 0.5 + 1
					v325("CoinTick", v326)
				end
				if v322 >= 1 then
					break
				end
				task.wait(0.05)
				v315 = v324
			end
			v315 = v324
			v314 = v318
		end
	end
	p304.coinScale.Scale = 1.2
	v_u_5.tween(p304.coinScale, v_u_5.M.Pop, {
		["Scale"] = 1
	})
	return true
end

function v_u_4.para(p72, p73) -- name: para
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7
	local v74 = p73.Size
	local v75 = v74.X
	local v76 = v74.Y
	local v77 = p73.Slant or v_u_4.SLANT
	local v78 = math.rad(v77)
	local v79 = math.tan(v78)
	local v80 = v76 * math.abs(v79)
	local v81 = p73.Edges or "both"
	local v82
	if v81 == "right" then
		v82 = -v76 * 2
	else
		v82 = v80 / 2
	end
	local v83
	if v81 == "left" then
		v83 = v75 + v76 * 2
	else
		v83 = v75 - v80 / 2
	end
	local v84 = v_u_6("Frame", {
		["Name"] = nil,
		["AnchorPoint"] = nil,
		["Position"] = nil,
		["Size"] = nil,
		["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1,
		["ClipsDescendants"] = true,
		["ZIndex"] = nil,
		["LayoutOrder"] = nil,
		["Visible"] = nil,
		["Name"] = p73.Name or "Para",
		["AnchorPoint"] = p73.AnchorPoint or Vector2.zero,
		["Position"] = p73.Position or UDim2.new(),
		["Size"] = UDim2.fromOffset(v75, v76),
		["ZIndex"] = p73.ZIndex or 1,
		["LayoutOrder"] = p73.LayoutOrder or 0,
		["Visible"] = p73.Visible ~= false
	}, p72)
	local v85 = (v83 - v82) * math.cos(v78)
	local v86 = math.sin(v78)
	local v87 = (v76 + v85 * math.abs(v86)) / math.cos(v78) + 2
	return v84, v_u_6("Frame", {
		["Name"] = "Fill",
		["AnchorPoint"] = nil,
		["Position"] = nil,
		["Size"] = nil,
		["Rotation"] = nil,
		["BackgroundColor3"] = nil,
		["BackgroundTransparency"] = nil,
		["BorderSizePixel"] = 0,
		["ZIndex"] = nil,
		["AnchorPoint"] = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, (v82 + v83) / 2, 0.5, 0),
		["Size"] = UDim2.fromOffset(v85, v87),
		["Rotation"] = v77,
		["BackgroundColor3"] = p73.Color or v_u_7.Navy,
		["BackgroundTransparency"] = p73.Transparency or 0,
		["ZIndex"] = p73.ZIndex or 1
	}, v84)
end
function v_u_4.resizePara(p88, p89, p90) -- name: resizePara
	local v91 = p88.Size.Y.Offset
	local v92 = p89.Rotation
	local v93 = math.rad(v92)
	local v94 = math.tan(v93)
	local v95 = (p90 - v91 * math.abs(v94)) * math.cos(v93)
	p88.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(p90, v91)
	p89.Position = UDim2.new(0, p90 / 2, 0.5, 0)
	local v96 = UDim2.fromOffset
	local v97 = math.sin(v93)
	p89.Size = v96(v95, (v91 + v95 * math.abs(v97)) / math.cos(v93) + 2)
end
function v_u_4.paraGradient(p98, p99, p100, p101, p102) -- name: paraGradient
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6
	local v103 = p98.Rotation
	local v104 = math.rad(v103)
	local v105 = p98.Size.X.Offset
	local v106 = p98.Size.Y.Offset * math.cos(v104)
	local v107 = math.sin(v104)
	local v108 = p99 / (v106 + v105 * math.abs(v107))
	local v109 = math.clamp(v108, 0.02, 1)
	local v110 = 0.5 - v109 / 2
	local v111 = v109 / 2 + 0.5
	local v112 = {
		["Rotation"] = 90 - p98.Rotation,
		["Color"] = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, p100),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(v110, p100),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(v111, p101),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, p101)
		})
	}
	if p102 then
		v112.Transparency = p102
	end
	return v_u_6("UIGradient", v112, p98)
end

function v_u_4.hex(p138, p139) -- name: hex
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_7
	local v140 = p139.Height
	local v141
	if p139.Flat then
		v141 = v140 / 1.7320508075688772
	else
		v141 = v140 / 2
	end
	local v142
	if p139.Flat then
		v142 = Vector2.new(v140, 2 * v141)
	else
		v142 = Vector2.new(1.7320508075688772 * v141, v140)
	end
	local v143 = p139.AnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	local v144 = p139.Position or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	if p139.Flat and v143 ~= Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) then
		local v145 = (Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) - v143) * (Vector2.new(2 * v141, v140) - v142)
		v144 = v144 + UDim2.fromOffset(v145.X, v145.Y)
	end
	local v146 = v_u_4.sprite(p138, "hex_pointy", {
		["Name"] = p139.Name or "Hex",
		["AnchorPoint"] = v143,
		["Position"] = v144,
		["Size"] = UDim2.fromOffset(v142.X, v142.Y),
		["Rotation"] = p139.Flat and 90 or 0,
		["ScaleType"] = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
		["ImageColor3"] = p139.Color or v_u_7.Plate,
		["ImageTransparency"] = p139.Transparency or 0,
		["ZIndex"] = p139.ZIndex or 1
	}, {
		["Corner"] = UDim.new(0.3, 0)
	})
	return v146, v146, v141
end
function v_u_4.setHexColor(p147, p148, p149) -- name: setHexColor
	if typeof(p147) == "Instance" then
		if p147:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			if p148 then
				p147.ImageColor3 = p148
			end
			if p149 then
				p147.ImageTransparency = p149
				return
			end
		elseif p147:IsA("UIStroke") then
			if p148 then
				p147.Color = p148
			end
			if p149 then
				p147.Transparency = p149
				return
			end
		else
			if p148 then
				p147.BackgroundColor3 = p148
			end
			if p149 then
				p147.BackgroundTransparency = p149
			end
		end
	else
		for _, v150 in p147 do
			if v150:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				if p148 then
					v150.ImageColor3 = p148
				end
				if not p149 then
					continue
				end
				v150.ImageTransparency = p149
			elseif v150:IsA("UIStroke") then
				if p148 then
					v150.Color = p148
				end
				if not p149 then
					continue
				end
				v150.Transparency = p149
			else
				if p148 then
					v150.BackgroundColor3 = p148
				end
				if not p149 then
					continue
				end
				v150.BackgroundTransparency = p149
			end
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_172(p157) -- name: landingSlide
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_156, (copy) v_u_12

	if v158 <= 0 or (p157.moveState ~= "Air" or v_u_9.isGrappling()) then
		return false
	end

		local v160 = v159.X
		local v161 = v159.Z
		if Vector3.new(v160, 0, v161).Magnitude >= (v_u_10.MinSpeed or 0) then
			local v162 = v_u_9.getRoot()
			if not (v162 and v162.Parent) then

			local v164 = -v159.Y * v158
			local v165 = v_u_10.LandBufferHeight or (1 / 0)
			local v166 = v163 + math.min(v164, v165)

end

function v_u_24.hideDefaultJump(p273, p274) -- name: hideDefaultJump
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18

		p273.jumpWatch:Disconnect()
		p273.jumpWatch = nil
	end
	local v_u_275 = v_u_18.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
	if v_u_275 then
		v_u_275 = v_u_275:FindFirstChild("JumpButton", true)
	end
	if v_u_275 and v_u_275:IsA("GuiObject") then
		if p274 then
			v_u_275.Visible = false
			p273.jumpWatch = v_u_275:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_275
				if v_u_275.Visible then
					v_u_275.Visible = false
				end
			end)
		else
			v_u_275.Visible = true
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_24.toast(p_u_291, p292, p293, p294) -- name: toast
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_14
	local v295 = v_u_6.upper(p292)
	local v296 = string.gsub(v295, "[&<>]", {
		["&"] = "&amp;",
		["<"] = "&lt;",
		[">"] = "&gt;"
	})
	if type(p293) == "string" and p293 ~= "" then
		local v297 = v_u_6.upper(p293)
		v296 = v296 .. "  <font color=\"#AEB8CC\">\194\183  " .. string.gsub(v297, "[&<>]", {
			["&"] = "&amp;",
			["<"] = "&lt;",
			[">"] = "&gt;"
		}) .. "</font>"
	end
	p_u_291.toastToken = p_u_291.toastToken + 1
	local v_u_298 = p_u_291.toastToken
	p_u_291.toastLabel.Text = v296
	p_u_291.toastLabel.TextColor3 = p294 or v_u_14.LineWhite

end

function v_u_24.update(p314, p315) -- name: update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_84, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_99, (copy) v_u_78, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_122, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_172, (copy) v_u_116, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_107
	if p314.active then
		local v316 = p314.ultDeny
		local v317 = not v_u_21
		if v317 then
			v317 = os.clock() < p314.ultDenyUntil
		end
		v316.Visible = v317
		local v318
		if p314.actions.viewMode then
			v318 = p314.actions.viewMode()
		else
			v318 = nil
		end
		local v319 = v318 == "First" and "VIEW 1P" or (v318 == "Third" and "VIEW 3P" or "VIEW")
		if p314.viewText ~= v319 then
			p314.viewText = v319
			p314.pills.View.label.Text = v319
		end
		local v320 = p315.waveLeft > 0.02
		local v321 = p314.shoot
		local v322
		if v320 then
			local v323 = p315.waveLeft
			local v324 = p315.waveTotal
			v322 = v323 / math.max(0.01, v324)
		else
			v322 = 0
		end
		local v325 = math.clamp(v322, 0, 1)
		local v326 = v325 - v321.fraction
		if math.abs(v326) > 0.004 then
			v321.fraction = v325
			local v327 = v321.clip
			local v328 = UDim2.fromOffset
			local v329 = v321.d
			local v330 = v321.d * v325 + 0.5
			v327.Size = v328(v329, (math.floor(v330)))
		end
		local v331 = p314.shoot
		local v332
		if v320 and p315.waveLeft >= 0.95 then
			local v333 = p315.waveLeft
			local v334 = math.ceil(v333)
			v332 = tostring(v334)
		else
			v332 = nil
		end
		local v335 = v332 ~= nil
		v331.number.Visible = v335
		v331.icon.Visible = not v335
		if v335 then
			v_u_6.setText(v331.number, v332)
		end
		v_u_84(p314.shoot, p315.itemStunned == true)
		if p315.ampActive then
			local v336 = p314.amp
			local v337 = v_u_15.AmpActive
			local v338 = math.clamp(1, 0, 1)
			local v339 = v338 - v336.fraction
			if math.abs(v339) > 0.004 then
				v336.fraction = v338
				local v340 = v336.clip
				local v341 = UDim2.fromOffset
				local v342 = v336.d
				local v343 = v336.d * v338 + 0.5
				v340.Size = v341(v342, (math.floor(v343)))
			end
			if v337 then
				v336.fill.BackgroundColor3 = v337
			end
			v336.fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
			local v344 = p314.amp
			v344.number.Visible = false
			v344.icon.Visible = true
		elseif p315.ampLeft > 0.02 then
			local v345 = p314.amp
			local v346 = p315.ampLeft
			local v347 = p315.ampTotal
			local v348 = v346 / math.max(0.01, v347)

local function v_u_173(p169) -- name: rewardsByLevelOf
	local v170 = {}
	for _, v171 in p169.rewards or {} do
		if type(v171) ~= "table" then
			continue
		end
		local v172 = v171.level
		if type(v172) ~= "number" then
			continue
		end
		v170[v171.level] = v171
	end
	return v170
end

function v_u_6.savePercent(p86) -- name: savePercent
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6

		return nil

function v_u_6.ownsBundle(p90) -- name: ownsBundle
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6

		if v108 then
			v106 = v109

		v111 = v110

			v111 = v114
		end

		return v106, v111, v115

		local v117, v118 = pcall(v116, v115)
		if v117 then

function v_u_6.dailyShop(p128) -- name: dailyShop

	end
	local v153 = {}
	local v154 = v_u_3.rotation
	local v155, v156, v157 = pcall(v154, v129)
	if v155 and type(v156) == "table" then
		for _, v158 in v156 do
			local v159

local function v_u_637(p627) -- name: touchRadius
	if p627.touch == nil then
		local v628 = 0
		local v629 = p627.model
		if v629 then
			v629 = p627.model:FindFirstChild("Pedestal")
		end
		for _, v630 in not v629 and {} or v629:GetDescendants() do

				continue
			end

			local v632 = v630.Position.Z - p627.top.Z
			local v633 = Vector3.new(v631, 0, v632).Magnitude

			local v635 = v630.Size.Z
			local v636 = v633 + math.max(v634, v635) / 2
			v628 = math.max(v628, v636)
		end

	end
	return p627.touch
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_16

	if v80 == "Intermission" then

		local v82 = type(v81) ~= "number" and 0 or v81 - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

		local v87 = math.ceil(v86)

		return "INTERMISSION", v85, false, ("NEXT MATCH IN %*"):format((string.format("%d:%02d", v89 // 60, v89 % 60))), v84, false
	end
	local v90 = v79:GetAttribute("BlueScore") or 0
	local v91 = v79:GetAttribute("OrangeScore") or 0
	local v92 = "BLUE " .. v90
	local v93 = ("<font color=\"#%*\">%*</font>"):format(v_u_6.Style.team("Blue", "Neon"):ToHex(), v92)
	local v94 = v91 .. " ORANGE"

	if v80 == "Ended" then
		return "MATCH OVER", v_u_4.Colors.Muted, false, v95, "INTERMISSION NEXT \194\183 QUEUE NOW", false
	end
	local v96 = #v_u_27("Blue") + #v_u_27("Orange")

local function v_u_329(p318) -- name: stepBeams
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_9

		if not v320.beam then
			continue
		end

		if v321 > 250 then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v319, {
			["bay"] = v320,
			["distance"] = v321
		})

	table.sort(v319, function(p322, p323)
		return p322.distance < p323.distance
	end)
	local v324 = #v319
	local v325 = {}
	for v326 = 1, math.min(12, v324) do

function v_u_203.step(p275, p276) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_189, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_69
	local v277 = p276 - p275.born
	if p275.finger then
		v_u_189(p275.finger, p275.pose or "tap", v277)
	end
	if p275.thumb then
		local v278 = v277 * 3.141592653589793 * 2 / 1.8
		p275.thumb.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(v278) * 38, 0.5, math.sin(v278) * 38)
	end
	if p275.arcs then
		local v279 = v277 * 4
		local v280 = math.sin(v279)
		p275.arcs.glyph.Position = UDim2.new(0, v280 * 5 + 26, 0.5, 0)
		v_u_12.setBarsColor(p275.arcs.left, v_u_18.Lime, math.max(0, v280) * 0.6 + 0.15)
		local v281 = v_u_12.setBarsColor
		local v282 = p275.arcs.right
		local v283 = v_u_18.Lime
		local v284 = -v280
		v281(v282, v283, math.max(0, v284) * 0.6 + 0.15)
	end
	if p275.lit then
		local v285 = p275.lit
		local v286 = v277 * 6
		v285.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 - math.cos(v286) * 0.25
	end
	if p275.action == "ReleaseJump" and p275.main then
		local v287 = v277 % 0.8 / 0.8
		local v288
		if v287 < 0.35 then
			local v289 = v287 / 0.35 * 3.141592653589793
			v288 = math.sin(v289) * 9
		else
			v288 = 0
		end

	end
	local v290 = p275.chip or p275.marker
	if p275.world and v290 then
		local v291 = v_u_69(p275.world)
		v290.Visible = v291 ~= nil
		if v291 then

			local v293 = v291.X
			local v294 = v291.Y
			local v295 = v277 * 4
			v290.Position = v292(v293, 0, v294, math.sin(v295) * 6 + -46)
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_415(p386, p387) -- name: stepPointer
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_38
	local v388 = p386.getPos
	local v389, v390 = pcall(v388)
	local v391 = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if v389 and (typeof(v390) == "Vector3" and v391) then
		local v392 = v391.ViewportSize
		local v393 = v391:WorldToViewportPoint(v390)
		local v394 = v393.X / v392.X
		local v395 = v393.Y / v392.Y
		if v393.Z > 0 and (v394 > 0.04 and (v394 < 0.96 and (v395 > 0.04 and v395 < 0.96))) then
			p386.edge.Visible = false
		else
			local v396 = Vector2.new(v393.X - v392.X / 2, v393.Y - v392.Y / 2)
			if v393.Z < 0 then
				v396 = -v396
			end

			end

			local v400 = (v397.X / v398) ^ 2 + (v397.Y / v399) ^ 2
			local v401 = 1 / math.sqrt(v400)

				local v407 = v403 > 0.66 and v405 > 0.33 and 0.33 or v405
				local v408 = v403 < 0.3 and v407 > 0.55 and 0.55 or v407

			end

function v_u_28.focus(p671) -- name: focus

function v_u_28.word(p684, p685) -- name: word
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_37
	if v_u_27[p684] then
		if p684 == "GOAL" then
			v_u_15.compact(true)
		end
		local v686 = v_u_38 and v_u_38.HUD
		if v686 then
			v686 = v_u_38.HUD.callouts()
		end
		if v686 then
			if p684 == "GO" then
				v686:goBeat()
				return
			elseif p684 == "GOAL" then
				local v687
				if type(p685) == "table" then
					local v688 = p685.kmh
					if type(v688) == "number" then
						v687 = p685.kmh
					else
						v687 = nil
					end
				else
					v687 = nil
				end
				v686:goal("Blue", v_u_37.DisplayName, nil, v687)
				return
			elseif p684 == "SAVE" then
				v686:saveBeat("SAVE")
			elseif p684 == "READY" then
				v686:announcer("READY!")
			end
		else
			return
		end
	else
		if v_u_4:IsStudio() then
			warn("[TutorialUI] word() dropped a word outside Config.Tutorial.Words: " .. tostring(p684))
		end
		return
	end
end

local function v_u_419() -- name: autoOpen
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_70, (ref) v_u_43, (copy) v_u_344, (copy) v_u_370, (ref) v_u_54, (copy) v_u_408, (copy) v_u_16, (ref) v_u_71
	local v409 = os.clock()
	local v410 = os.clock()
	local v411 = 0
	local v412 = false
	while not v_u_70 do
		task.wait(1)
		local v413 = os.clock()
		local v414 = v413 - v410
		if v_u_70 then
			break
		end
		if v_u_43.FTUE == nil then
			local v415 = v_u_43.Session
			local v416
			if v415 == nil or v415.outcome == nil then
				v416 = false
			else
				v416 = v415.outcome() ~= nil
			end
			if v416 then
				break
			end
		end
		if v_u_344() then
			v412 = true
			if not v_u_370() then
				v411 = v411 + v414
			end
			local v417 = not v_u_54 and (v_u_344() and not v_u_370())
			if v417 then
				v417 = not v_u_408()
			end
			if v417 then
				if not v_u_16.claimable() then
					break
				end
				task.wait(1.5)
				if not v_u_70 then
					local v418 = not v_u_54 and (v_u_344() and not v_u_370())
					if v418 then
						v418 = not v_u_408()
					end
					if v418 and v_u_16.claimable() then
						v_u_16.open({
							["source"] = "auto"
						})
						break
					end
				end
			elseif v411 > 90 then
				break
			end
		elseif not v412 and v413 - v409 > 600 then
			break
		end
		v410 = v413
	end
	v_u_71 = true
end

	end

end

function v_u_7.canvas(p198) -- name: canvas
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_2
	local v199 = p198
	local v200 = nil
	while p198 and not v200 do
		v200 = p198:GetAttribute("SafeAspect")
		if type(v200) ~= "number" then
			v200 = nil
		end
		p198 = p198.Parent
	end
	if not v199:IsA("LayerCollector") then
		v199 = v199:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
	end
	local v201 = v_u_4.currentScale()
	local v202 = math.max(v201, 0.01)
	if not v_u_4.roomy(v199) then
		local _, v203 = v_u_4.safeArea(v199, v200)
		return v203 / v202
	end
	local v204 = v_u_2.CurrentCamera
	local v205
	if v204 then
		v205 = v204.ViewportSize
	else
		v205 = Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
	end
	return v205 / v202
end

function v_u_7.cardList() -- name: cardList
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_305, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7
	local v371, v372 = v_u_305("cardList")
	if v371 and type(v372) == "table" then
		return v372
	end
	local v373 = {}
	for v374, v375 in v_u_6.Items do
		if v375.Kind ~= "Banner" then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v373, v374)
	end
	table.sort(v373, function(p376, p377)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_6
		local v378 = v_u_7.isLimited(p376)
		if v378 ~= v_u_7.isLimited(p377) then
			return v378
		end
		local v379 = v_u_6.Items[p376]
		local v380 = v_u_6.Items[p377]
		local v381 = v379.Rarity
		if v381 then
			v381 = v_u_6.Rarities[v381]
		end
		local v382 = not v381 and 0 or v381.Order
		local v383 = v380.Rarity
		if v383 then
			v383 = v_u_6.Rarities[v383]
		end
		if v382 == (not v383 and 0 or v383.Order) then
			return v379.Name < v380.Name
		end
		local v384 = v379.Rarity
		if v384 then
			v384 = v_u_6.Rarities[v384]
		end
		local v385 = not v384 and 0 or v384.Order
		local v386 = v380.Rarity
		if v386 then
			v386 = v_u_6.Rarities[v386]
		end
		return (not v386 and 0 or v386.Order) < v385
	end)
	return v373
end

local function v_u_370() -- name: poolIds
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_25
	local v362 = {}
	for _, v363 in v_u_7.Order do
		if not v_u_7.Defs[v363].InPool then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v362, v363)
	end
	table.sort(v362, function(p364, p365)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_25
		local v366 = v_u_7.Defs[p364]
		local v367 = v_u_7.Defs[p365]
		local v368 = v_u_25[v366.Rarity]
		local v369 = v_u_25[v367.Rarity]
		if v368 == v369 then
			return v366.Order < v367.Order
		else
			return v369 < v368
		end
	end)
	return v362
end
